name: System Configuration
description: System configuration — also called config, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), Terraform/Ansible state, environment settings, secrets, or .env/config files — the settings and definitions governing how systems run. Tampering or leakage of it undermines every other control. The place to look for configuration, IaC/Terraform, environment and app settings, secrets, or the data defining how the system is set up.
